ModMetaData.name: RimMT
ModMetaData.author: Allen / Rimworld-Project
ModMetaData.description: Compatibility-first performance and multithreading runtime for RimWorld 1.5. Includes a bounded worker pool, safe main-thread dispatch, Harmony conflict detection, circuit breakers, text/UI scan caches and optional short-lived reachability miss caching. Invasive Pawn/Thing/Reservation parallel ticking stays disabled.
